button._comment: One uniform size for every button (Call/Add contact/Continue/...) — the approved design artifact gives every action button in the 'Quieter' direction the identical chrome (8px/16px padding, 8px radius). A `compact` (8px/4px) tier existed briefly for Delete/Call/Add contact when those carried a text label or sat tightly packed in a contact row; all three are icon-only now and have moved back to this one base size (explicit request — more breathing room around a fixed-size icon), so it's gone rather than kept as an unused tier.

buttonTint._comment: Shared alpha stops behind TvButton's tint system (MainActivity.kt) and .tv-button's web equivalent — a translucent fill whose border only appears on focus (neutralBorder and accentBorder are 0: no border at rest, by design), with meaning carried by hue (neutral=white, accent=the button's own status/action color). 'accent' covers both Success and Danger tints, which share the same alpha stops and differ only in hue. The border keeps its width at rest (just fully transparent) so focusing never shifts layout. The step-slider and switch borders in MainActivity.kt use the same Border/BorderFocused pairs.
